output.preview: This essay will discuss climate change and agriculture. Climate change has serious effects on farmers. Extreme temperatures can reduce crop production, and irregular rainfall can affect planting schedules.

pipeline.name: Sentence Segmentation

sentences.text: This essay will discuss climate change and agriculture.
Climate change has serious effects on farmers.
Extreme temperatures can reduce crop production, and irregular rainfall can affect planting schedules.

pipeline.purpose: Split the original text into sentences with exact character offsets using the spaCy sentence parser.

pipeline.name: Tokenization
pipeline.process: spaCy Doc token iterator; offsets via token.idx
pipeline.purpose: Break the spaCy document into linguistic tokens while preserving exact original-text offsets.

pipeline.name: Lemmatization
pipeline.purpose: Record each token's dictionary base form (lemma) next to its surface form. The student's word is never replaced.
pipeline.timing_note: Extracted in the same single spaCy pass as tokenization; shares the token-capture timing.

pipeline.name: Stopword Identification
pipeline.purpose: Flag whether spaCy classifies each token as a stopword. Nothing is deleted; flags stay visible in the trace.
pipeline.timing_note: Extracted in the same single spaCy pass as tokenization; shares the token-capture timing.

pipeline.name: POS Tagging
pipeline.purpose: Record each token's coarse part-of-speech, detailed tag, and dependency label from the spaCy parse.
pipeline.timing_note: Extracted in the same single spaCy pass as tokenization; shares the token-capture timing.

pipeline.process: NLTK WordNet lookup + filtering (6 documented rules)
pipeline.purpose: Look up teacher/topic terms in the real NLTK WordNet database, filter candidates with documented rules, and match retained terms against student content.

pipeline.name: TF-IDF Vectorization

output.corpus_limitation: With 2 documents, IDF only distinguishes 'term in both docs' (idf ~1.0) from 'term in one doc' (idf ~1.405). This is a transparent starting point, NOT a trained semantic model.

pipeline.purpose: Vectorize the 2-document corpus (topic doc vs student doc) with scikit-learn TF-IDF. Honest 2-doc IDF limitation documented.

pipeline.name: Cosine Similarity
pipeline.purpose: Compute real cosine similarity between topic and student vectors (library), verified by a genuine manual dot/norm calculation.

pipeline.name: Topic Classification

output.threshold_warning: CONFIGURABLE DEVELOPMENT THRESHOLDS — PENDING EMPIRICAL VALIDATION. Not scientifically proven.

pipeline.purpose: Compare similarity against configurable development thresholds (WEAK/MODERATE/STRONG, pending empirical validation).

pipeline.name: Explainable Feedback
